description: This PHP file provides the backend and frontend components for mass-changing the status or owner of Lead records within the vtiger CRM system. It includes logic for handling form submissions, displaying selection options, and JavaScript functions for UI interactions.

classes.name: Leads
classes.description: A class representing Lead entities within vtiger CRM. Used here to access and modify lead data.

methods.name: getComboArray
methods.description: Fetches key-value pairs for dropdown options based on provided field names.

methods.name: get_select_options_with_id
methods.description: Generates HTML option elements for select inputs, associating display text with IDs.

methods.name: get_module_title
methods.description: Creates a title header section for module pages with optional subheading.
